source: Extracted 2026-10-04 from app/Livewire/Admin/ContactControlCenter/ContactWizard.php (public properties) and contact-wizard.blade.php + partials/*-row-fields.blade.php, cross-checked so no public property is missed. Keys are the Livewire property names. Required = UI asterisk or PHP validate(). Labels are humanised from keys; confirm against the UI.
note: Visibility per contact type is admin-configurable (FosFieldVisibilityRule); VendorOS registration is limited to Vendor and Partner types.
